subject: BeaconLedger: latency variance after model v5b rollout
messages:
From: Marcus Chen <marcus.chen@beaconledger.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: BeaconLedger SRE <sre@beaconledger.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden latency and 5xxs after v5b rollout

Hi Olga,

We started seeing a significant increase in tail latency and a small but growing 5xx rate on our inference traffic starting ~08:45 PST after you rolled v5b/quant-profile-3 into prod. P95 jumped from 180ms to 1.2s and P99 to ~3.6s; throughput is throttling under normal load. We attached a short trace set and some sample error responses.

This is customer-facing — a feature gating that relies on sub-200ms responses. Can you confirm whether Redwood made any config changes for our account today? We need an ETA for mitigation, and if rollback is possible immediately, please advise.

-Marcus
Product Engineering, BeaconLedger

Attachments: p99_traces_20261107.zip, sample_error_responses.txt

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lina Gomez <lina@beaconledger.com>, BeaconLedger SRE <sre@beaconledger.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden latency and 5xxs after v5b rollout

Thanks Marcus — I see the traces, and I'm escalating this now. I'm pinging our SRE and inference leads. Short answers before we align: we did push v5b with quant-profile-3 to the BeaconLedger route as part of the scheduled model improvement (commit v5b @ 08:30 PST). There were no infra capacity changes on our side at that time.

I will coordinate immediate mitigation steps (fallback to v5a or disabled quantization) and propose a timeboxed rollback if needed. I'll provide a clear action plan in the next 30 minutes.

— Olga
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Sudden latency and 5xxs after v5b rollout — BeaconLedger (urgent)

Team — forwarding customer report. TL;DR: v5b + quant-profile-3 rolled 08:30 PST; customer showing p99 -> 3.6s, p95 -> 1.2s, some 5xxs. BeaconLedger is highly sensitive to p95/p99; we have an active enterprise deal (DL-4829) and this is getting CXO visibility. Please treat as P0.

What I need: 1) Quick diagnostic of root cause hypotheses (model compute vs qprofile-induced decode stalls vs config mismatch). 2) Mitigation path we can execute within 30–60 minutes (prefer rollback, or immediate per-account routing to v5a). 3) Clear comms to customer with ETA.

Notes from customer's traces I pulled: heavy tail on long sequences; KV cache hit rate looks normal in their traces; errors look like ephemeral decode timeouts rather than model logits anomalies. Attached: their trace bundle.

If we need to escalate higher (legal/cto), I'll loop them in, but let's see if ops can get us a rollback or routing fallback quickly.

— Olga

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sudden latency and 5xxs after v5b rollout — BeaconLedger (urgent)

Acknowledged — jumping in. Quick tech notes:
- Initial triage (simulated on canary) shows latency tail correlated with quant-profile-3 activation on GPU kernels for long sequences (>512 tokens); we see intermittent kernel stalls in the v5b execution path that don't appear on v5a.
- Error samples are decode timeouts (we time out the call at 10s after retriable backoff), which aligns with user traces.

Immediate mitigation plan (30–45m):
1) Route 100% of BeaconLedger traffic back to pinned model v5a (we have version pinning for this account). This is the fastest reversible path.
2) Disable quant-profile-3 for v5b on BeaconLedger route (if they want to keep v5b's weights and lose qprofile improvements).
3) Enable temporary autoscale bump for their dedicated pool and monitor p95/p99 (we can do an emergency CPU/GPU burst for 2 hours).
4) Collect a deeper kernel-level trace and open a hotfix branch to remove the qprofile kernel path for long sequences.

I'll start with (1) and (3) — routing change should be seconds to apply and visible within a minute; autoscale bump will take ~5–10 minutes to spin nodes. If we see success, we'll keep v5a while we debug v5b.

I'll post updates in 15 minutes with metrics.

— Rishi
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Chen <marcus.chen@beaconledger.com>, Lina Gomez <lina@beaconledger.com>
Cc: BeaconLedger SRE <sre@beaconledger.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -08:00
Subject: BeaconLedger update: routing rollback applied, monitoring, next steps

Marcus / Lina —

Status update (short):
- At 10:07 PST on Nov 7 we routed BeaconLedger back to v5a (pinned). Immediate effect: p95 reduced from ~1.2s to ~210ms within two minutes; p99 dropped from ~3.6s to ~360ms. 5xxs stopped.
- We also applied a temporary autoscale bump for the dedicated pool (10:12 PST) which increased headroom during recovery.
- Rishi's team collected kernel traces and identified quant-profile-3 long-sequence kernel path as the leading hypothesis; we are iterating a hotfix.

Next steps and asks:
- We recommend staying on v5a for BeaconLedger for the next 48 hours while we validate the v5b qprofile hotfix on a wider canary cohort (we will not auto-promote until validated).
- If you prefer to be on v5b without qprofile optimizations, we can re-route to v5b with quant disabled for your account; this preserves model behavior while avoiding the problematic kernel path.
- We'll send a technical postmortem within 72 hours and include kernel-level traces and timeline.

I realize this drew exec attention on both sides. If BeaconLedger would like, I can schedule a 30-minute call with our CTO and Rishi to review root cause and compensating controls. Please let me know your preference.

Appreciate your patience — full PM + SRE support until this is closed.

— Olga Petrov
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0128
